fill: Original image per-channel median, computed over the entire original RGB image, rounded down to uint8. Identical fill for target and background.
score: Sum of full-vocabulary log probabilities for the reference label and EOS, conditional on the fixed image and original question.
comparison: For each eligible image compute original minus target-occluded score and original minus background-occluded score. Positive paired difference indicates a larger score drop for target occlusion.
limitations: Boxes may omit targets; median fill may introduce artifacts; background position is deterministic and may differ in visual content. Development diagnosis only.
